summary: Bug fix verified for discount-debt issue. All 5 pytest tests passed (100%). The bug where discounts were incorrectly recorded as customer debt has been fixed in backend/routes/sales.py. Verification shows all recent sales with discounts have debt_amount=0 as expected.

discount_debt_bug_tests: test_01_sale_with_manual_discount_no_debt - PASSED: Manual discount applied, debt_amount=0
test_04_sale_without_discount_normal - PASSED: Sale without discount works normally
api_tests: test_sale_with_discount_via_api - PASSED: 2500 GNF discount, final total 8500 GNF, debt=0
test_sale_with_product_discount_via_api - PASSED: 1500 GNF product discount, debt=0
database_verification: All 10 recent sales with discounts verified - NO INCORRECT DEBT

bug_fix_verification.original_issue: Quand un rabais est appliqué à une vente, le montant du rabais était incorrectement enregistré comme une dette client
bug_fix_verification.root_cause: In backend/routes/sales.py create_sale(), only discount_amount (manual discount) was used instead of calculating total_discount_amount (manual + promo + auto + product discounts)
bug_fix_verification.fix_description: Changed to calculate total_discount_amount = manual_discount + promo_discount + auto_discount + product_discounts. The final_total is now correctly calculated as subtotal - total_discount_amount
bug_fix_verification.verification_method: 5 pytest tests + API tests + database verification of 10 recent sales

critical_code_review_comments: Bug fix correctly implemented in sales.py lines 252-264
All discount types now properly summed: manual + promo + automatic + product
debt_amount correctly remains 0 when payment is complete (amount_paid = final_total)
Frontend properly sends discount data to backend API
seed_data_creation: Test sales created via API during test execution
